name: Trezukar
backstory: Child of Trezarlo and Forliukar; grew up around settles the house's accounts at the market stalls... in Terfila, and knows something of Birth Of Merkhaubo.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Learned that Farmuken has died.
Grew up hearing: Learned that Farlo has died.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Tamuzco and Forliamuk now have a child, Tamuzaken.
Had a child with Forliauken, named Forliaukar.
Had a child with Tamuzco, named Trezukuzco.
Had a child with Tamuzaken, named Tamuzakar.
Heard that Forliauken and Farliukar now have a child, Forliaukarla.
Had a child with Tamuzaken, named Trezukaken.
Heard that Tamuzarlo and Farliauzco now have a child, Tamuzauzco.

criterion.standard: holds themself accountable to Birth Of Darinak, whatever it costs
criterion.wasted_life: one that never had to answer for Birth Of Darinak
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: walks the transit route on his own errands when the harbor's dead time drags on, and can't pass the temple without pausing, the way the family always has.

arc.premise: Trezukar wants word of that birth carried properly to the relations who haven't heard yet, rather than let it reach them secondhand and thin.
